verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents OneDrive Files On-Demand in File Explorer, which lets users browse files without downloading them, and a right-click 'Always keep on this device' option for offline use. That establishes a Windows desktop client with online-only files. A community user also reports files syncing across their computers without problems, while other users report files deleted, reverted, or altered during sync, which tempers confidence in 'just works'. Missing for 10: any evidence of an official macOS client, documented selective sync (choosing which folders sync), and in-depth first-party sync-client documentation.

support.subject: As a power user, sync just works on my machines — official desktop clients across macOS/Windows with selective sync and on-demand (online-only) files

citations.quote: OneDrive Files On-Demand enables users to view, search for, and interact with files stored in OneDrive from within File Explorer, without downloading all the files to their device.
